description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget representing the main activity screen of a mobile app, including a Scaffold with AppBar and Drawer, handling navigation via different fragments (pages). It models the home activity, with logic to select and display various fragments based on drawer selection, and includes user profile display in the drawer header.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main widget representing the home activity, managing navigation drawer and content fragments, with properties for user info.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class for HomeActivity handling UI state, drawer selection, and rendering relevant fragments.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: Model class for drawer menu items, holding icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeActivity widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes user display name and email from passed props or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the scaffold with app bar, drawer, and body based on selected menu.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer with header and items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the fragment widget corresponding to the selected drawer item.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates the selected drawer index and closes the drawer.
